name: 28504 · Kinston, NC
findings: ZIP 28504 (Kinston) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28504 (Kinston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
